6432.title: Tunnel test typecheck passes in clean checkouts
6432.rootCauseOneLine: Reported failure not established: forced typechecks pass in two clean worktrees and imported declarations include Node Buffer types despite types: [].

prReviews.topFinding: The assertion change removes an implicit Node-global dependency; the reported current-main typecheck failure did not reproduce. No PR code was executed.

6432.proposedFix: First reproduce with the reporter's Node version and compare resolved compiler declarations; no fix PR is justified until trusted-main failure reproduces.
6432.caveats: Node 22.19.0 differs from the reported Node 24.15.0. Low confidence in the original failure's cause; both clean typechecks and all 22 existing tests passed. The harness and output are inline, per reports repository policy.
